events.label: "Odysseus finishes his tale and the Phaeacians sit in silence."
"Bring out one more chest, and let every lord of Phaeacia add a tripod and a cauldron to it..."
"At sunset Odysseus boards the convoy ship and lies on a prepared bed in the stern."
"The crew carries the sleeping man and his treasure onto the shore."
